column1: # Per okderators-catalog-index branch: what catalog-edit.sh (MODE=catalog) adds, and which installed
# CSVs the graph walk starts from. Tab-separated, one row per branch; lists are comma-separated CSV
#   REPLACES   the new entry's replaces: the channel's single head before the edit, read 2026-11-02;
#              any other head stops the branch. Nothing is removed. NONE: the branch has no package,
#              catalog-edit.sh creates it, and an existing catalog/cluster-kube-descheduler-operator/
#   INSTALLED  CSVs a cluster may run; {DATE-1d} is the new bundle's DATE a day earlier: the shape of
#              our test CSV, for the later move of this cluster to the official build. NONE goes with
#              REPLACES=NONE: a fresh package has no installed CSV to reach the head from.
